Sure Excellent call guys ! Ty West Call Ended : Nice Session With More Than 33 Other Members Shoot I missed it 😩 Is there a recording? I Dont Think So Any comment on where to go for deep reading on L1 sharding / security into the consensus ? Please DM as much as you like. Appreciate it. Ty We don't record these calls unfortunately, helps allow them to be comfortable and candid Me Too Intestested In L2 Sharding and Security Do Send Me Stuff Personally Or Here. It was great meeting y'all! <@!364458974906548225> Gotcha. Is there another meeting happening soon? It's possible that people may send you things to read, but my guess is that you may need to go spelunking in either the channel history of this server, or the https://ethresear.ch/ forums, prior blog posts, etc. Anyone who wants a calendar invite to the standup calls, DM me with 1) East/West/Both 2) The email address to send the invite to For anyone looking to learn more about the network layer of Ethereum, the official spec is probably the best place to start: https://github.com/ethereum/devp2p. It gives a great technical spec but imo lacks a bit on the design rationale and linking everything together. maybe makes a lot more sense if you have a networking background/are familiar with kademlia. I try to address some of those issues in my (half-baked) devp2p guidebook: https://rebel-bronze-539.notion.site/The-Devp2p-Guidebook-WIP-17f5805c9efc46edadc39f2b5a316d7a. ~~Apologies if this has been asked already - it sounds like the process for finding a CDAP project is to identify something you are interested in and then to define your own project.
